g.text: Objective: turn the resolved assumptions into an intrinsic value per share with a two-stage discounted cash flow (DCF), or stop when the company cannot be valued.
back to the analyze board
tax and bankruptcy odds are set
the diluted shares are plausible
every assumption has a source
the ticker cannot be valued (exit code 1)
the weighted average cost of capital (WACC) is computed

text.tspan: the years are projected
per year: earnings before interest and taxes (EBIT), net operating profit after tax (NOPAT), free cash flow to the firm (FCFF)

g.text: the terminal value is computed

text.tspan: the enterprise value is found
enterprise value (EV): the value of the whole company

g.text: the equity value is found
the company has an intrinsic value
terminal growth is sourced
the dataset region is set
the capital scalars are sourced
the two-way grid is done
the one-at-a-time sensitivity is done

text.tspan: Comes out:
the intrinsic value per share, EV, equity value = intrinsic value per share × diluted shares, terminal value share, WACC and the year table

g.text: tax rate and bankruptcy odds are set [no story; tax manual, sector, country, or 25%; bankruptcy manual or 0]

text.tspan: tax rate and bankruptcy odds are set, then the story shapes the ten-year paths [hypergrowth story type]
growth, margin, weighted average cost of capital (WACC) and tax rate become yearly paths, each value sourced story

g.text: the ticker cannot be valued, exit code 1 [hypergrowth, and no latest revenue, a year-10 revenue no growth rate reaches, or no terminal weighted average cost of capital (WACC), terminal growth or tax rate]
the ticker cannot be valued, exit code 1 [the override file is not valid YAML, not a mapping, has an unknown key or a value that is not a finite number, or its story file is inconsistent]
the ticker cannot be valued, exit code 1 [both weights set by hand and not summing to 1]
the ticker cannot be valued, exit code 1 [no revenue in the newest year]
the ticker cannot be valued, exit code 1 [diluted shares missing or outside 1,000,000 to 100,000,000,000]

text.tspan: the diluted shares are plausible
[shares present and inside the plausible range]

g.text: the ticker cannot be valued, exit code 1 [an assumption is unresolved]
every assumption has a source
the ticker cannot be valued, exit code 1 [sales-to-capital at most 0, or an empty growth path]

text.tspan: the weighted average cost of capital (WACC) is computed [one rate from the weights, or the story's yearly path]
WACC = equity weight × cost of equity + debt weight × pre-tax cost of debt × (1 − tax)
with a story: WACC_t = the story's path, no weights; the last year's WACC is the terminal WACC

g.text: the ticker cannot be valued, exit code 1 [terminal growth at or above the weighted average cost of capital (WACC)]

text.tspan: the years are projected [terminal growth below the last year's weighted average cost of capital (WACC); a cumulative discount with a WACC path]
for t = 1 … N, N = length of the growth path, 10 unless a manual list differs, 10 with a story
revenue_t = revenue_t−1 × (1 + g_t), revenue_0 = latest revenue
EBIT_t = revenue_t × margin_t
NOPAT_t = EBIT_t × (1 − tax)
reinvestment_t = (revenue_t − revenue_t−1) ÷ sales-to-capital
FCFF_t = NOPAT_t − reinvestment_t
present value_t = FCFF_t ÷ (1 + WACC)^t
with a WACC path: discount factor_t = cumulative product of 1 ÷ (1 + WACC_k), k = 1 … t; present value_t = FCFF_t × discount factor_t
with a story: NOPAT_t = EBIT_t × (1 − tax_t), the story's yearly tax rate
the terminal value is computed [with a terminal return on invested capital (ROIC) the reinvestment is g ÷ ROIC of the profit, else by sales-to-capital]
terminal year N + 1: revenue = revenue_N × (1 + g_terminal), margin_N; FCFF_N+1 by the same formulas, with the scalar tax
with a terminal ROIC: reinvestment = NOPAT_N+1 × g ÷ ROIC, g = g_terminal
terminal value = FCFF_N+1 ÷ (WACC − g_terminal)
present value of terminal value = terminal value ÷ (1 + WACC)^N
with a WACC path: WACC = WACC_N, and present value of terminal value = terminal value × the last cumulative discount factor
the enterprise value is summed
EV = Σ present value_t + present value of terminal value
terminal value share = present value of terminal value ÷ EV (0 when EV = 0)
equity and the going-concern value per share are found [fixed commitments subtracted and extra cash added when the story sets them]
equity = EV − net debt + adjustments
with a story: − fixed commitments + extra cash
going-concern value per share = equity ÷ diluted shares
the intrinsic value per share blends going concern and distress [per share, or on the enterprise value before the bridge with a hypergrowth story]
intrinsic value per share = (1 − p) × going-concern value per share + p × distress value per share, p = bankruptcy odds

with a hypergrowth story (proceeds share 0 by default): EV after failure = (1 − p) × EV + p × proceeds share × EV, before the bridge; then equity = the bridge on EV after failure, intrinsic value per share = equity ÷ diluted shares

g.text: the ticker cannot be valued, exit code 1 [a scenario cannot be built, or its terminal growth reaches its weighted average cost of capital (WACC)]
each assumption is moved to 0.8 and 1.2 times, one at a time
the value, its parts and the year table go on to the sensitivity [always]
